ideas.title: Signal-Garrison
ideas.core_fantasy: The player inhabits this premise: a constrained moving vessel, body, machine, or route becomes the dungeon, making navigation, repair, threat, and identity overlap.
player_loop: Read a concrete situation shaped by vehicle or body as dungeon.
Choose how to interrupt the bodies through cockpit hud gesture zones.
Spend, gain, or contaminate one visible state axis.
Let layered vehicle audio model alter the next draw or route.
Resolve a later echo that proves the previous choice mattered.
signature_systems: Highway vehicle survivorlike: make lane pressure a player-facing rule, not just lore.
Layered vehicle audio model: make license manifest a production constraint with a visible review or validation step.
Cockpit HUD gesture zones: make dashboard frame a player-facing rule, not just lore.
Pursuer rearm gap: make health/readiness a player-facing rule, not just lore.
content_pipeline: Start from layered vehicle audio model.
Keep prose, mechanics, and validation as separate artifacts.
Accept content only when choices produce readable state changes and later consequences.
prototype_scope: Two resource axes and one delayed consequence queue.
One review command that prints why each event was selected.
validation_plan: Create a tiny schema for rooms/events/actions before writing content.
Generate 6-10 sample records and run an action-ID/dangling-reference audit.
Build one review surface or CLI output that shows state before and after each choice.
Prototype the riskiest piece first: Invisible cooldown rules.
design_questions: What forces the player to change lanes?
What converts contact into harvest, flee, or death?
